tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to be bereaved, make childless, miscarry
1a) (Qal) to be bereaved
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to make childless
1b2) to cause barrenness, show barrenness or abortion
1b3) to miscarry
1c) (Hiphil) miscarrying (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.
